status: FROZEN before training. O1R = O1 + a standing residual correct-slot term. The coefficient 0.01 is preregistered, NOT a tuning start point.
base_objective: O1: L_addr = -log(r[q, s*] + 1e-6); s* = argmax_j stop_gradient(w[f,j]); read/write addresses from the frozen capture hook; no answer labels

coefficient_schedule.residual_note: the ONLY change vs O1 is a constant 0.01 floor for steps 601-1200 instead of 0.0

target_definition: read probability r[q, s*] on the stop-gradient top-write slot s*, per layer, mean over layers and batch
reduction: mean over aux-probe batch and layers
masking: aux needle-probe fact/query positions only (same as O1); supervised main target unchanged (answer position mask at pos-1)
prohibitions: if 0.01 fails, REPORT the failure before proposing any other coefficient
inference_statement: training-only auxiliary loss; auxiliary objective absent at evaluation; no new inference-time operation or parameter
pass_rule: O1R does NOT pass by retaining correct-slot probability alone; at step 1200 every forming seed must ALSO collapse under both slots-off and frozen randomized-addressing per the unchanged causal gate
